## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List local checks and any native screenshots. State what remains untested.

For changes that add or move code, confirm that all owned executable code is Rust and report the local [Rust-only policy check](https://github.com/viggomeesters/ruycast/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#rust-only-source-policy).

## Privacy and compatibility

Confirm that the change preserves existing configuration and permissions, and excludes personal profiles, clipboard data, private logs and signing material.
